description: This file defines a template class 'FastUniformBits' for efficiently generating uniform random bits from a URBG (Uniform Random Bit Generator) concept, including utility functions and internal mechanisms for bit masking and range calculations.

classes.name: FastUniformBits
classes.description: A template class providing fast methods to generate uniform independent bits from a URBG, with internal mechanisms for handling different range sizes and rejection sampling.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates a random value using the provided URBG, dispatching to either a simplified or rejection-based generation method.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Internal method to generate random bits, either via a simplified loop for power-of-two ranges or via rejection sampling for arbitrary ranges.
